articles.title: Private keys, not smart contracts, caused 40% of crypto's $16 billion hack losses. Here's whats being done.
articles.snippet: The industry is moving toward fixing the private key vulnerability issue, just not evenly, Wish Wu, co-founder and CEO of Pharos, said.

articles.title: Can AI drain DeFi? Separating Claude Mythos hype from reality
articles.snippet: Claude Mythos has raised concerns about AI-driven attacks on DeFi protocols. However, the same AI tools are also available to security teams, not just attackers.

articles.title: Linux Foundation, Tech Giants Launch Akrites to Defend Open Source Against AI-Powered Attacks
articles.snippet: A coalition of 19 organizations—including every major AI lab and Wall Street banks—just built the security team that open-source maintainers never had.
